instruction: Navigate to the Chrome settings page where you can manage site permissions and privacy controls.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome content settings (site permissions and privacy controls). Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/content. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree address bar
Metric appropriately compares URLs while ignoring query parameters (suitable for Chrome settings pages)
Expected URL 'chrome://settings/content' correctly corresponds to the site permissions and privacy controls page
URL prefix handling is correct (goto_prefix is empty for chrome:// internal URLs)
Single-step verification matches the single-step navigation instruction
Chrome internal settings pages are stable and don't typically require postconfig to reopen
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding a fallback check in case Chrome is not the active window, though this is unlikely to be needed for Chrome internal pages
Minor: The static validation warning about UI-dependent tasks is overly cautious here - Chrome settings pages remain accessible after navigation
